name: manifesto-montage
label: Manifesto montage (Nike / Gymshark brand film)
description: VO manifesto over documentary/athlete montage, building from solo instrument to full, ending on a held thesis image and tagline card.

sync.broll: metaphor and real-effort footage cut to the VO cadence; 60-90%
sync.fillers: match cuts, speed ramps on effort peaks (sparingly)
sync.music: solo instrument → full build; impacts on ≤ 3 key words; drop to silence before the final line
sync.emotion_map: defiance/recognition → struggle → rising pride → conviction (silence) → belonging (tagline)
sync.transitions: hard cuts on the beat, one held final image

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: no body shaming or before/after transformations
supplement claims only in label-approved wording
